Constraints.description: Optional soft preferences; exceeding these never rejects a candidate.

max_darkness_hours.description: Soft preference: maximum continuous darkness, in hours
max_darkness_hours.title: Max Darkness Hours

max_earth_blackout_hours.description: Soft preference: maximum continuous loss of Earth-centre LOS, in hours
max_earth_blackout_hours.title: Max Earth Blackout Hours

Constraints.title: Constraints

min_contact_minutes.description: Minimum continuous usable Earth-centre LOS after setup
min_contact_minutes.title: Min Contact Minutes

required_windows.description: Number of distinct qualifying visibility windows, not sessions packed into one window
required_windows.title: Required Windows

first_contact_deadline_minutes.description: Minutes since mission start by which setup plus one complete qualifying contact must finish
first_contact_deadline_minutes.title: First Contact Deadline Minutes

description: Compatibility name for the shared mission request.

evaluation_policy.description: hard_first stops on a proven sampled hard failure; complete retains all diagnostics for comparison
evaluation_policy.title: Evaluation Policy

illumination_model.description: solar_disc: time-mean visible solar-disc area including Earth occultation; sun_center: explicit legacy geometric centre model
illumination_model.title: Illumination Model

start_utc.description: Timezone-aware ISO 8601 on an exact 5-minute UTC grid
start_utc.title: Start Utc

duration_hours.description: At least 1 hour, in 5-minute increments; no application maximum; may be omitted with end_utc
duration_hours.title: Duration Hours

end_utc.description: Alternative UTC end date; must agree with duration_hours if both are supplied
end_utc.title: End Utc

min_sunlit_fraction.description: Minimum time-mean visible solar-disc fraction (0–1) under the default solar_disc model
min_sunlit_fraction.title: Min Sunlit Fraction

resolve_indeterminate.description: Complete missing validation, refine horizon at most twice, and check robust sampled mission paths; full-circle warnings and mission thresholds are retained
resolve_indeterminate.title: Resolve Indeterminate
